stem:
Rekha lists stages of the water cycle, starting from the Sun heating water in lakes and rivers.

Which sequence is correct?

options.text: Evaporation and transpiration → rising and cooling of water vapour → condensation into clouds → precipitation → seepage and return to water bodies
Evaporation and transpiration → rising of water vapour → evaporation into clouds → precipitation → seepage and return to water bodies
Evaporation and transpiration → rising of water vapour with no cooling → condensation into clouds → precipitation → seepage and return to water bodies
Evaporation and transpiration → condensation into clouds → rising and cooling of water vapour → precipitation → seepage and return to water bodies

teacher.key_rationale: Solar heating drives evaporation and transpiration; vapour rises and cools, then condenses into clouds, then precipitation and return flow. Calling cloud formation evaporation swaps terms; dropping cooling omits a needed condition; putting condensation before rising and cooling reverses the order.
